title: 8.4 family — full-metric cross-engine
subtitle: MyVector 8.4 · vsql_vector (VillageSQL 8.4) · pgvector · MariaDB — fashion-mnist-784
nav: 9.7 family → · real-dataset (MySQL versions) · village (recall/QPS) · cross-engine · MySQL versions
description: The MySQL 8.4 family of the full-metric cross-engine comparison, measured through MyVector's own harness (so insert throughput, exact-KNN, and ANN p50/p99 are all here, unlike the village recall/QPS view). MyVector and VillageSQL's vsql_vector each have an 8.4 and a 9.7 build; this page is their 8.4 builds, with pgvector and MariaDB as fixed anchors. The 9.7 family is the companion page.
caveats: Full metrics via MyVector's harness (bench_real / bench_mariadb_real / bench_pgvector_real / bench_vsql_real): index build, insert QPS, exact brute-force KNN (QPS + p50/p99), ANN (QPS + p50/p99), and recall@10 vs the dataset's published ground truth.
Dataset: fashion-mnist-784-euclidean (60k train × 784-d, 10k test, L2). HNSW M=16, ef_construction=200 for MyVector/vsql_vector/pgvector; MariaDB's MHNSW fixes ef_construction at 10 internally.

Family = MySQL base: MyVector 8.4 = the component on stock MySQL 8.4; vsql_vector (8.4) = the VillageSQL extension on the VillageSQL 8.4 dev-server. pgvector (Postgres) and MariaDB are engine-fixed and appear in both family pages as anchors.

Cache parity: each engine's graph sized above the ~188 MB index (MyVector in-memory HNSW + 2 GB InnoDB pool; vsql 2 GB InnoDB pool; pgvector shared_buffers 2 GB; MariaDB mhnsw_max_cache_size 1 GiB). Headline cards are the warm ef_search=200 point.
Hardware: all engines on the same Ampere A1 dev host. MyVector 8.4 and MariaDB are reused from the real-dataset run (same host/dataset/params).
